summary: iShares Ethereum Trust ETF filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-3 reverse split of its shares, approved by sponsor iShares Delaware Trust Sponsor LLC on July 31, 2026. The split becomes effective October 6, 2026, with a record date of October 5, 2026. Each three shares will combine into one share, proportionally reducing shares outstanding and increasing NAV per share. Total shareholder investment value and trust assets are unchanged. No fractional shares will be issued; proportional fractional interests will be redeemed for cash to shareholders' brokerage accounts, potentially creating tax consequences. This is a routine share-consolidation event, not a special situation. Watch for trading adjustments on Nasdaq and potential tax effects for holders receiving cash in lieu of fractional shares.
